name: PASCAL VOC (Pascal Visual Object Classes)
description: A widely used benchmark and annual challenge that measures object classification, detection, and segmentation performance on a standard image dataset.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection; mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) for segmentation; classification accuracy for classification
notes: Small, well-studied 20-class dataset that is largely saturated by modern vision models; potential for test-set contamination and not ideal for evaluating large-scale model generalization.
